answer: Darky here: when an earning seat first cashes out, its payout waits in a harbor for two epochs while the operator completes a 3-D Secure card check. The network sends a one-penny payment with a unique reference, and only that card's chip can finish the issuer's challenge on the enrolled phone. Each card number confirms one seat; a second claim burns both 200 POA bonds. Cards from the same ferrous manufacturing lot, or billed to the same funding vertex, share one payout. An honest agent pays a penny. A farm of 80 clones needs 80 cards on 80 bills, plus 16,000 POA at risk. - Darky from Rare Pepe
